841.name: DOUT 1 Overcurrent
841.description: DOUT 1 Overcurrent IO element is used to indicate overcurrent on Digital Output 1. When Digital Output 1 overcurrent happens, it means that current level is > 300 mA, value is set to 1. Value 1 holds until 5 min timeout runs out. After timeout value is set to 0 if current level is < 300 mA. If current level is still > 300 mA value remains 1.

842.name: DOUT2 Overcurrent
842.description: DOUT 2 Overcurrent IO element is used to indicate overcurrent on Digital Output 2. When Digital Output 2 overcurrent happens, it means that current level is > 300 mA, value is set to 1. Value 1 holds until 5 min timeout runs out. After timeout value is set to 0 if current level is < 300 mA. If current level is still > 300 mA value remains 1.

930.name: Accelerator Pedal 1 Low Idle Switch
930.description: Switch signal which indicates the state of the accelerator pedal 1 low idle switch. 0 - Accelerator pedal 1 not in low idle condition 1 - Accelerator pedal 1 in low idle condition 2 - Error 3 - Not available

931.name: Accelerator Pedal Kickdown Switch
931.description: Switch signal which indicates whether the accelerator pedal kickdown switch is opened or closed. 0 - Kickdown passive 1 - Kickdown active 2 - Error 3 - Not available

932.name: Road Speed Limit Status
932.description: Status (active or not active) of the system used to limit maximum vehicle velocity. 0 - Active 1 - Not Active 2 - Error 3 - Not available

933.name: Accelerator Pedal 2 Low Idle Switch
933.description: Switch signal which indicates the state of the accelerator pedal 2 low idle switch. 0 - Accelerator pedal 2 not in low idle condition 1 - Accelerator pedal 2 in low idle condition 2 - Error 3 - Not available

934.name: Accelerator Pedal Position 1
934.description: This parameter is intended for the primary accelerator control in an application.

936.name: Engine Percent Load At Current Speed
936.description: The ratio of actual engine percent torque (indicated) to maximum indicated torque available at the current engine speed, clipped to zero torque during engine braking.

937.name: Remote Accelerator Pedal Position
937.description: The ratio of actual position of the remote analog engine speed/torque request input device (such as an accelerator pedal or throttle lever) to the maximum position of the input device.

938.name: Accelerator Pedal 2 Position
938.description: The ratio of actual position of the second analog engine speed/torque request input device (such as an accelerator pedal or throttle lever) to the maximum position of the input device. This parameter is intended for secondary accelerator control in an application.

939.name: Vehicle Acceleration Rate Limit Status
939.description: Status (active or not active) of the system used to limit maximum forward vehicle acceleration. 0 - Limit not active 1 - Limit active 2 - Reserved 3 - Not available

940.name: Momentary Engine Maximum Power Enable Feedback
940.description: Momentarily requesting Engine Maximum Power Enable - feature support feedback 0 - disabled 1 - supported 2 - reserved 3 - don't care

941.name: DPF Thermal Management Active
941.description: Indicates that the exhaust temperatures have been elevated for regeneration of the diesel particulate filter aftertreatment system or in preparation of regeneration of the diesel particulate aftertreatment system. 0 - DPF Thermal Management is not active 1 - DPF Thermal Management is active 2 - Reserved 3 - Don't care

942.name: SCR Thermal Management Active
942.description: Indicates that the exhaust temperatures have been elevated for regeneration of the SCR aftertreatment system or in preparation of regeneration of the SCR aftertreatment system. 0 - SCR Thermal Management is not active 1 - SCR Thermal Management is active 2 - Reserved 3 - Don't care

943.name: Actual Maximum Available Engine - Percent Torque
943.description: This is the maximum amount of torque that the engine can immediately deliver as a percentage of the reference engine torque.

944.name: Estimated Pumping - Percent Torque
944.description: The calculated torque that indicates the estimated amount of torque loss due to the engine air handling system.

945.name: Engine Torque Mode
945.description: State signal which indicates which engine torque mode is currently generating, limiting, or controlling the torque. Mode 0 - “No request”: engine torque may range from 0 to full load only due to low idle governor output. Modes 1 to 14 indicate that there is either a torque request or the identified function is currently controlling the engine: engine torque may range from 0 (no fueling) to the upper limit. Mode 15 -

946.name: Actual Engine - Percent Torque (Fractional)
946.description: This parameter displays an additional torque in percent of the reference engine torque. 0 - +0.000% 1 - +0.125% ... 9 - +0.875% 10 to 15 - not available

947.name: Driver’s Demand Engine - Percent Torque
947.description: The requested torque output of the engine by the driver.

948.name: Actual Engine - Percent Torque
948.description: The calculated output torque of the engine.

949.name: Engine Speed
949.description: Actual engine speed which is calculated over a minimum crankshaft angle of 720 degrees divided by the number of cylinders.

950.name: Source Address of Controlling Device for Engine Control
950.description: The source address of the SAE J1939 device currently controlling the engine.

951.name: Engine Starter Mode
951.description: There are several phases in a starting action and different reasons why a start cannot take place. 0 - start not requested 1 - starter active but not engaged 2 - starter active and engaged 3 - start finished; starter not active after having been actively engaged (after 50ms mode goes to 0) 4 - starter inhibited due to engine already running 5 - starter inhibited due to engine not ready for start (preheating) 6 - starter inhibited due to driveline engaged or other transmission inhibit 7 - starter inhibited due to active immobilizer 8 - starter inhibited due to starter over-temp 9 - starter inhibited due to intake air shutoff valve being active 10 - starter inhibited due to active emissions control system condition 11 - starter inhibited due to ignition key cycle required 12 - starter inhibited - reason unknown 13 - error (legacy implementation only, use 14) 14 - error 15 - not available

952.name: Engine Demand – Percent Torque
952.description: The calculated torque that indicates the estimated amount of torque loss due to the engine air handling system.

953.name: Aftertreatment 1 Diesel Oxidation Catalyst Intake Temperature
953.description: Temperature of engine combustion byproducts entering the diesel oxidation catalyst in exhaust bank 1.

954.name: Aftertreatment 1 Diesel Oxidation Catalyst Outlet Temperature
954.description: Temperature of engine combustion byproducts leaving the diesel oxidation catalyst exhaust in exhaust bank 1.

955.name: Aftertreatment 1 Diesel Oxidation Catalyst Differential Pressure
955.description: Exhaust differential pressure measured between the intake and exhaust of a diesel oxidation catalyst in exhaust bank 1.

956.name: Aftertreatment 1 Diesel Oxidation Catalyst Intake Temperature Preliminary FMI
956.description: Used to identify the applicable J1939-73 FMI detected in the diesel oxidation catalyst intake temperature sensor by the manufacturer’s sensor control software in exhaust bank 1. A value of 31 is sent to indicate that no failure has been detected or this parameter is not supported.

957.name: Aftertreatment 1 Diesel Oxidation Catalyst Outlet Temperature Preliminary FMI
957.description: Used to identify the applicable J1939-73 FMI detected in the diesel oxidation catalyst outlet gas temperature sensor by the manufacturer’s sensor control software in exhaust bank 1. A value of 31 is sent to indicate that no failure has been detected or this parameter is not supported.

958.name: Aftertreatment 1 Diesel Oxidation Catalyst Differential Pressure Preliminary FMI
958.description: Used to identify the applicable J1939-73 FMI detected in the diesel oxidation catalyst differential pressure sensor by the manufacturer’s sensor control software in exhaust bank 1. A value of 31 is sent to indicate that no failure has been detected or this parameter is not supported.

959.name: Aftertreatment 1 Diesel Particulate Filter Soot Load Percent
959.description: Indicates the soot load percent of diesel particulate filter 1.

960.name: Aftertreatment 1 Diesel Particulate Filter Ash Load Percent
960.description: Indicates the ash load percent of diesel particulate filter 1.

961.name: Aftertreatment 1 Diesel Particulate Filter Time Since Last Active Regeneration
961.description: Indicates the time since the last active regeneration event of diesel particulate filter 1.

962.name: Aftertreatment 1 Diesel Particulate Filter Soot Load Regeneration Threshold
962.description: This parameter indicates the value that will first cause DPF regeneration in aftertreatment 1.

963.name: Aftertreatment 1 Exhaust Temperature 2
963.description: The reading from the exhaust temperature sensor located midstream of the other two temperature sensors in the aftertreatment system in exhaust bank 1.

964.name: Aftertreatment 1 Diesel Particulate Filter Intermediate Temperature
964.description: Temperature of engine combustion byproducts at a mid-point in the diesel particulate filter in exhaust bank 1.

965.name: Aftertreatment 1 Diesel Particulate Filter Differential Pressure
965.description: Exhaust differential pressure measured between the intake and exhaust of a diesel particulate filter in exhaust bank 1.

966.name: Aftertreatment 1 Exhaust Temperature 2 Preliminary FMI
966.description: Used to identify the applicable J1939-73 FMI detected in the exhaust temperature 2 sensor by the manufacturer’s sensor control software in exhaust bank 1. In the case of multiple failures the most severe is communicated. A value of 31 is sent to indicate that no failure has been detected or this parameter is not supported.

967.name: Aftertreatment 1 Diesel Particulate Filter Differential Pressure Preliminary FMI
967.description: Used to identify the applicable J1939-73 FMI detected in the diesel particulate filter differential pressure sensor by the manufacturer’s sensor control software in exhaust bank 1. In the case of multiple failures the most severe is communicated. A value of 31 is sent to indicate that no failure has been detected or this parameter is not supported.

968.name: Aftertreatment 1 Diesel Particulate Filter Intermediate Temperature Preliminary FMI
968.description: Used to identify the applicable J1939-73 FMI detected in the diesel particulate filter intermediate temperature sensor by the manufacturer’s sensor control software in exhaust bank 1. In the case of multiple failures the most severe is communicated. A value of 31 is sent to indicate that no failure has been detected or this parameter is not supported.

969.name: Aftertreatment 1 Exhaust Temperature 1
969.description: The reading from the exhaust temperature sensor located farthest upstream in the aftertreatment system in exhaust bank 1.

970.name: Aftertreatment 1 Diesel Particulate Filter Intake Temperature
970.description: Temperature of engine combustion byproducts entering the diesel particulate filter in exhaust bank 1.

971.name: Aftertreatment 1 Exhaust Temperature 1 Preliminary FMI
971.description: Used to identify the applicable J1939-73 FMI detected in the exhaust temperature 1 sensor by the manufacturer’s sensor control software in exhaust bank 1. In the case of multiple failures the most severe is communicated. A value of 31 is sent to indicate that no failure has been detected or this parameter is not supported.

972.name: Aftertreatment 1 Diesel Particulate Filter Intake Temperature Preliminary FMI
972.description: Used to identify the applicable J1939-73 FMI detected in the diesel particulate filter intake temperature sensor by the manufacturer’s sensor control software in exhaust bank 1. In the case of multiple failures the most severe is communicated. A value of 31 is sent to indicate that no failure has been detected or this parameter is not supported.

973.name: Trip Fuel (Gaseous)
973.description: Total fuel consumed (trip drive fuel + trip PTO governor moving fuel + trip PTO governor non-moving fuel + trip idle fuel) since the last trip reset.

974.name: Total Fuel Used (Gaseous)
974.description: Total fuel consumed (trip drive fuel + trip PTO governor moving fuel + trip PTO governor non-moving fuel + trip idle fuel) over the life of the engine.

989.name: Trip Vehicle Distance
989.description: Distance traveled during all or part of a journey.

990.name: Total Vehicle Distance
990.description: Accumulated distance traveled by vehicle during its operation.

991.name: Engine Total Hours of Operation
991.description: Accumulated time of operation of engine.

992.name: Engine Total Revolutions
992.description: Accumulated number of revolutions of engine crankshaft during its operation.

993.name: Total Vehicle Hours
993.description: Accumulated time of operation of vehicle.

994.name: Total Power Takeoff Hours
994.description: Accumulated time of operation of power takeoff device.

995.name: Engine Trip Fuel
995.description: Fuel consumed during all or part of a journey.

996.name: Engine Total Fuel Used
996.description: Accumulated amount of fuel used during vehicle operation.

1002.name: Engine Coolant Temperature
1002.description: Temperature of liquid found in engine cooling system.

1003.name: Engine Fuel 1 Temperature 1
1003.description: Temperature of fuel (or gas) of the first fuel type.

1006.name: Engine Intercooler Temperature
1006.description: Temperature of liquid found in the intercooler located after the turbocharger.

1007.name: Engine Charge Air Cooler Thermostat Opening
1007.description: The current position of the thermostat used to regulate the temperature of the engine charge air cooler. A value of 0% represents the thermostat being completely closed and 100% represents the thermostat being completely open.

1008.name: Engine Fuel Delivery Pressure
1008.description: Gage pressure of fuel in system as delivered from supply pump to the injection pump.

1009.name: Engine Extended Crankcase Blow-by Pressure
1009.description: Differential crankcase blow-by pressure as measured through a tube with a venturi.

1010.name: Engine Oil Level
1010.description: Ratio of current volume of engine sump oil to maximum required volume.

1011.name: Engine Oil Pressure 1
1011.description: Gage pressure of oil in engine lubrication system as provided by oil pump.

1012.name: Engine Crankcase Pressure 1
1012.description: First instance of the gage pressure inside engine crankcase.

1013.name: Engine Coolant Pressure 1
1013.description: Gage pressure of liquid found in engine cooling system.

1014.name: Engine Coolant Level 1
1014.description: Ratio of volume of liquid found in engine cooling system to total cooling system volume.

1015.name: Two Speed Axle Switch
1015.description: Switch signal which indicates the current axle range. 0 - Low speed range 1 - High speed range 2 - Error 3 - Not available

1016.name: Two Speed Axle Switch
1016.description: Switch signal which indicates when the parking brake is set. 0 - Parking brake not set 1 - Parking brake set 2 - Error 3 - Not available

1017.name: Cruise Control Pause Switch
1017.description: Switch signal which indicates the position of the Cruise Control Pause Switch used on Remote Cruise Control applications. The Cruise Control Pause Switch signal temporarily disables the Cruise Control function. 0 - Off 1 - On 2 - Error Indicator 3 - Take No Action

1018.name: Park Brake Release Inhibit Request
1018.description: Park Brake Release Inhibit Request signals the desire that an applied park brake remain applied and limit the ability of the vehicle to be moved. 0 - Park Brake Release Inhibit not requested 1 - Park Brake Release Inhibit requested 2 - SAE reserved 3 - Unavailable

1019.name: Wheel-Based Vehicle Speed
1019.description: Speed of the vehicle as calculated from wheel or tailshaft speed.

1020.name: Cruise Control Active
1020.description: Cruise control is switched on. 0 - Cruise control switched off 1 - Cruise control switched on 2 - Error 3 - Not available

1021.name: Cruise Control Enable Switch
1021.description: Switch signal which indicates that it is possible to manage the cruise control function. 0 - Cruise control disabled 1 - Cruise control enabled 2 - Error 3 - Not available

1022.name: Brake Switch
1022.description: Switch signal which indicates that the driver operated brake foot pedal is being pressed. 0 - Brake pedal released 1 - Brake pedal depressed 2 - Error 3 - Not Available

1023.name: Clutch Switch
1023.description: Switch signal which indicates that the clutch pedal is being pressed. 0 - Clutch pedal released 1 - Clutch pedal 2 - Error 3 - Not available

1024.name: Cruise Control Set Switch
1024.description: Switch signal of the cruise control activator which indicates that the activator is in the position "set." 0 - Cruise control activator not in the position "set" 1 - Cruise control activator in position "set" 2 - Error 3 - Not available

1025.name: Cruise Control Coast (Decelerate) Switch
1025.description: Switch signal of the cruise control activator which indicates that the activator is in the position "coast (decelerate)." 0 - Cruise control activator not in the position "coast" 1 - Cruise control activator in position "coast" 2 - Error 3 - Not available

1026.name: Cruise Control Resume Switch
1026.description: Switch signal of the cruise control activator which indicates that the activator is in the position "resume." 0 - Cruise control activator not in the position "resume" 1 - Cruise control activator in position "resume" 2 - Error 3 - Not available

1027.name: Cruise Control Accelerate Switch
1027.description: Switch signal of the cruise control activator which indicates that the activator is in the position "accelerate." 0 - Cruise control activator not in the position "accelerate" 1 - Cruise control activator in position "accelerate" 2 - Error 3 - Not available

1028.name: Cruise Control Set Speed
1028.description: Value of set (chosen) velocity of velocity control system.

1029.name: PTO Governor State
1029.description: Cruise control is switched on. It is not ensured that the engine is controlled by cruise control, as in the case of a large driver's demand the engine is controlled by the driver while cruise control is active (maximum selection of cruise control and driver's demand). 0 - Cruise control switched off 1 - Cruise control switched on 2 - Error 3 - Not available

1030.name: Cruise Control States
1030.description: This parameter is used to indicate the current state or mode of operation by the power takeoff (PTO) governor. 0 - Off/Disabled 1 - Hold 2 - Remote Hold 3 - Standby 4 - Remote Standby 5 - Set 6 - Decelerate/Coast 7 - Resume 8 - Accelerate 9 - Accelerator Override 10 - Preprogrammed set speed 1 11 - Preprogrammed set speed 2 12 - Preprogrammed set speed 3 13 - Preprogrammed set speed 4 14 - Preprogrammed set speed 5 15 - Preprogrammed set speed 6 16 - Preprogrammed set speed 7 17 - Preprogrammed set speed 8 18 - PTO set speed memory 1 19 - PTO set speed memory 2 20 - PTO set speed memory 3 21 - Reserved 22 - Reserved 23 - Reserved 24 - Reserved 25 - Reserved 26 - Reserved 27 - Reserved 28 - Reserved 29 - Reserved 30 - Reserved 31 - Not available

1031.name: Engine Idle Increment Switch
1031.description: This parameter is used to indicate the current state, or mode, of operation by the cruise control device. This is a status parameter. 0 - Off/Disabled 1 - Hold 2 - Accelerate 3 - Decelerate 4 - Resume 5 - Set 6 - Accelerator Override 7 - Not available

1032.name: Engine Idle Decrement Switch
1032.description: Switch signal which indicates the position of the idle increment switch. 0 - Off 1 - On 2 - Error 3 - Not available

1033.name: Engine Diagnostic Test Mode Switch
1033.description: Switch signal which indicates the position of the idle decrement switch. 0 - Off 1 - On 2 - Error 3 - Not available

1034.name: Engine Shutdown Override Switch
1034.description: Switch signal which indicates the position of the engine shutdown override switch. This switch function allows the operator to override an impending engine shutdown. 0 - Off 1 - On 2 - Error 3 - Not available

1035.name: Engine Fuel Rate
1035.description: Amount of fuel consumed by engine per unit of time.

1036.name: Engine Instantaneous Fuel Economy
1036.description: Current fuel economy at current vehicle velocity.

1037.name: Engine Average Fuel Economy
1037.description: Average of instantaneous fuel economy for that segment of vehicle operation of interest.

1038.name: Engine Throttle Valve 1 Position 1
1038.description: The position of the valve used to regulate the supply of a fluid, usually air or fuel/air mixture, to an engine. 0% represents no supply and 100% is full supply.

1039.name: Engine Throttle Valve 2 Position
1039.description: The sensed position feedback of the valve, coming from a second electrical actuator for a second throttle plate, used to regulate the supply of a fluid, usually air or fuel//air mixture. 0% represents no supply and 100% is full supply.

1040.name: Barometric Pressure
1040.description: Absolute air pressure of the atmosphere.

1041.name: Cab Interior Temperature
1041.description: Temperature of air inside the part of the vehicle that encloses the driver and vehicle operating controls.

1043.name: Engine Intake 1 Air Temperature
1043.description: Temperature of air entering vehicle air induction system.

1044.name: Road Surface Temperature
1044.description: Indicated temperature of road surface over which vehicle is operating.

1045.name: Aftertreatment 1 Diesel Particulate Filter Intake Pressure
1045.description: Exhaust pressure as a result of particle accumulation on filter media placed in the exhaust stream.

1046.name: Engine Intake Manifold #1 Pressure
1046.description: The gauge pressure measurement of the air intake manifold. If there are multiple air pressure sensors in the intake stream, this is the last one in flow direction before entering the combustion chamber. This should be the pressure used to drive gauges and displays.

1047.name: Engine Intake Manifold 1 Temperature
1047.description: Temperature of pre-combustion air found in intake manifold of engine air supply system.

1048.name: Engine Intake Air Pressure
1048.description: Absolute air pressure at input port to intake manifold or air box.

1049.name: Engine Air Filter 1 Differential Pressure
1049.description: Change in engine air system pressure, measured across the filter, due to the filter and any accumulation of solid foreign matter on or in the filter.

1050.name: Engine Exhaust Temperature
1050.description: Temperature of combustion byproducts leaving the engine.

1051.name: Engine Coolant Filter Differential Pressure
1051.description: Change in coolant pressure, measured across the filter, due to the filter and any accumulation of solid or semisolid matter on or in the filter.

1052.name: SLI Battery 1 Net Current
1052.description: Net flow of electrical current into/out of the first battery or first set of batteries used for starting the engine, for lighting, and for ignition (SLI).

1053.name: Alternator Current
1053.description: Measure of electrical current flow from the alternator.

1054.name: Charging System Potential (Voltage)
1054.description: Electrical potential measured at the charging system output. The charging system may be any device charging the batteries. This includes alternators, generators, solid state charger and other charging devices.

1055.name: Battery Potential / Power Input 1
1055.description: This parameter measures the first source of battery potential as measured at the input of the ECU/actuator etc. coming from one or more batteries, irrespective of the distance between the component and the battery.

1056.name: Key Switch Battery Potential
1056.description: Battery potential measured at the input of the electronic control unit supplied through a key switch or similar switching device.

1057.name: Transmission Clutch 1 Pressure
1057.description: Gage pressure of oil within a wet clutch.

1058.name: Transmission Oil Level 1
1058.description: First instance of a transmission oil level indicator. Conveys the ratio of volume of transmission sump oil to recommended volume.

1059.name: Transmission Filter Differential Pressure
1059.description: Change in transmission fluid pressure, measured after the filter, due to accumulation of solid or semisolid material on or in the filter.

1060.name: Transmission 1 Oil Pressure
1060.description: Gage pressure of lubrication fluid in transmission 1, measured after pump.

1061.name: Transmission Oil Temperature 1
1061.description: First instance of transmission lubricant temperature.

1062.name: Transmission Oil Level 1 High / Low
1062.description: First instance of a transmission oil level indicator. Conveys the amount of current volume of transmission sump oil compared to recommended volume. Positive values indicate overfill. Zero means the transmission fluild is filled to the recommended level.

1063.name: Transmission Oil Level 1 Countdown Timer
1063.description: Countdown timer for the first instance of a transmission oil level indicator. Once all vehicle conditions (such as vehicle stopped, etc) are met, some transmissions may require a 'settling time' to allow the fluid level to normalize. This parameter indicates how much of the required settling time remains. 0 - less than 1 minute 1 - One minute 2 - Two minutes 3 - Three minutes 4 - Four minutes 5 - Five minutes 6 - Six minutes 7 - Seven minutes 8 - Eight minutes 9 - Nine minutes 10 - Ten minutes 11 - Eleven minutes 12 - Twelve minutes 13 - Thirteen minutes 14 - Error 15 - Not Available

1064.name: Transmission Oil Level 1 Measurement Status
1064.description: Measurement status for the first instance of a transmission oil level indicator. If conditions are not acceptable, this parameter conveys to the operator what prevents conditions from being acceptable. 0 - Conditions valid for transmission oil level measurement 1 - Conditions not valid – Settling timer still counting down 2 - Conditions not valid – Transmission in gear 3 - Conditions not valid – Transmission fluid temperature too low 4 - Conditions not valid – Transmission fluid temperature too high 5 - Conditions not valid – Vehicle moving; output shaft speed too high 6 - Conditions not valid – Vehicle not level 7 - Conditions not valid – Engine speed too low 8 - Conditions not valid – Engine speed too high 9 - Conditions not valid – No request for reading 10 - Not defined 11 - Not defined 12 - Not defined 13 - Conditions not valid - Other 14 - Error 15 - Not available

1065.name: Washer Fluid Level
1065.description: Ratio of volume of liquid to total container volume of fluid reservoir in windshield wash system.

1066.name: Fuel Level 1
1066.description: Ratio of volume of fuel to the total volume of fuel storage container.

1067.name: Engine Fuel Filter Differential Pressure
1067.description: Change in fuel delivery pressure, measured across the filter, due to accumulation of solid or semisolid matter on the filter element.

1068.name: Engine Oil Filter Differential Pressure
1068.description: Change in engine oil pressure, measured across the filter, due to the filter and any accumulation of solid or semisolid material on or in the filter.

1069.name: Cargo Ambient Temperature
1069.description: Temperature of air inside vehicle container used to accommodate cargo.

1070.name: Fuel Level 2
1070.description: Ratio of volume of fuel to the total volume of fuel in the second or right-side storage container.

1071.name: Engine Oil Filter Differential Pressure (Extended Range)
1071.description: Change in engine oil pressure, measured across the filter, due to the filter and any accumulation of solid or semisolid material on or in the filter.
